items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unlaunched; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Maintain the concrete private-site decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence for each property by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task may close without direct evidence. Existing progress is limited to official source review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle; do not create duplicate evidence work or send outreach.

Keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not expand alerts, monetize, deploy, change credentials or configuration, or add dependencies.
